d: BEST GENSHIN IMPACT SKINS 40 | #genshinimpact #genshin #геншинимпакт #геншин Genshin Impact — это масштабная приключенческая ролевая игра с открытым миром и элементами гача, разработанная китайской студией HoYoverse (ранее известной как miHoYo) и завоевавшая многомиллионную аудиторию по всему миру с момента своего релиза в 2020 году. Действие игры разворачивается в сказочном фэнтезийном мире под названием Тейват, состоящем из семи уникальных королевств, каждое из которых находится под покровительством своего Архонта — божества, олицетворяющего одну из семи стихий: Анемо (ветер), Гео (землю), Электро (электричество), Дендро (природу), Гидро (воду), Пиро (огонь) и Крио (лёд). Завязка сюжета начинается с того, что главный герой, известный как Путешественник или Путешественница, вместе со своим близнецом путешествовал между мирами, но столкнулся с таинственной безымянной богиней, которая разлучила родных людей, лишила их сил и запечатала в Тейвате. Проснувшись спустя сотни лет, главный герой встречает крошечную и жизнерадостную спутницу по имени Паймон, которая становится его гидом, и вместе они отправляются в грандиозное странствие по всем регионам, чтобы вернуть утраченного близнеца и разгадать секреты этого загадочного мира. В процессе своего путешествия игрок посещает невероятно разнообразные земли: свободолюбивый Мондштадт, вдохновлённый средневековой Европой; величественный и контрастный Ли Юэ, созданный на основе древнекитайской культуры и философии; изолированную и суровую островную Инадзуму с эстетикой феодальной Японии; утопающий в джунглях и пустынях Сумеру, впитавший мотивы Южной Азии и Ближнего Востока; прогрессивный и изысканный Фонтейн, выполненный в стиле стимпанка и Прекрасной эпохи Франции, а также другие развивающиеся регионы Тейвата. Повествование отличается огромной глубиной и проработанностью лора, заложенного не только в эпических Заданиях Архонтов и личных историях персонажей, но и в описаниях предметов, прочитанных книгах, древних фресках и руинах, что постепенно открывает перед игроком мрачную историю павшей цивилизации Каэнри'ах и загадочный небесный порядок Селестии. Основой игрового процесса является свобода исследования огромного бесшовного мира и динамичная боевая система, завязанная на элементальном взаимодействии. Игроки могут беспрепятственно перемещаться по живописным локациям, карабкаться по отвесным скалам, парить на планере, плавать, погружаться под воду и решать сотни уникальных головоломок, скрывающих ценные сокровища и тайники. Боевая система строится на создании отряда из четырёх персонажей, между которыми можно мгновенно переключаться прямо во время сражения. Главная фишка боёв — элементальные реакции: наложение одной стихии на другую вызывает мощные визуальные и боевые эффекты, такие как Пар, Таяние, Заморозка, Перегрузка, Раздувание, Кристаллизация, а также сложнейшие Дендро-реакции вроде Бутонизации и Стимуляции. Это побуждает постоянно экспериментировать с составом команды, подбирая героев с синергирующими способностями для эффективного прохождения испытаний, витых бездн и битв с гигантскими боссами. Визуально Genshin Impact выполнена в сказочном аниме-стиле с высочайшим уровнем детализации, динамичной сменой времени суток и реалистичными погодными условиями, создающими невероятно атмосферную картинку. Особого упоминания заслуживает музыкальное сопровождение, созданное внутренней студией HOYO-MiX и записанное крупнейшими мировыми симфоническими оркестрами. Музыка в игре глубоко отражает культурные особенности каждого региона благодаря гармоничному сочетанию классических симфонических инструментов и аутентичных народных мотивов разных стран мира. Игра распространяется по бесплатной модели Free-to-Play и получает масштабные контентные обновления каждые шесть недель, которые постоянно добавляют новые территории, персонажей, сюжетные главы и временные события.

d: Embers of the Uncrowned is a newly announced dark-fantasy MMORPG from Nexon that leans heavily into Diablo-style isometric combat, combining fast, skill-based action with brutal, gore-filled visuals. Set on a war-torn continent devastated by a massive elven invasion, the game puts you in the role of the last heir to a fallen noble house, fighting to reclaim your land and restore your legacy. (Gematsu) Combat is designed to be both fast and tactical, with multiple distinct classes like the Spectral Blade, Executioner, and Stormbringer, each offering unique abilities and playstyles. You’ll also recruit companions and team up with other players to take on massive bosses, raids, and large-scale PvE threats that require coordination and strategy. (Gematsu) Beyond combat, the game features settlement building and progression systems, letting you grow your domain from a small camp into a thriving city as you liberate regions and expand your influence. With deep customization, co-op gameplay, and a grim narrative, Embers of the Uncrowned aims to deliver a brutal, modern take on the MMORPG formula. d: capital rift is a browser game built on the real world map. its all pulled from openstreetmap so you can go find your actual street and play there, and everyone is in the same persistent world. heres everything you can actually do FOOD CART - pick one of 7 cuisines (hotdog, burger, sushi, crepe, fish n chips, pizza, burrito), thats your run - cook it yourself with a minigame per cuisine, scrub it down when it gets gross - set your price, watch your appeal, 6 upgrade tracks that go to lvl 10 - run a whole fleet of them, buy more carts on the market and drop them wherever you want - same cuisine parked too close to you is competition so pick your spots WORKERS - hire people off the street, they show up as real 3d characters you drag onto a business - random star rating, they level up while they work, and they only get paid while theyre actually producing - cook, then auto buy ingredients, then auto price, then auto clean, then just faster - roles for everything: cart, shop cashier, warehouse, farmer, farm hand, miner, builder, driver - all of it keeps running while youre offline PROPERTY - rent a room, buy the whole building, or build your own from scratch out of materials - room editor: place furniture, add and remove windows and doors, merge rooms together - rent your rooms out to npcs or other players and collect the rent - walk inside anything, the roof cuts away and you can go floor to floor SHOPS - turn a room into a store, put in shelves and a register, list what you want and price it - npc customers actually walk in and buy off your shelves - hire a cashier so it runs without you LAND - buy plots anywhere on the map, shift click to grab a bunch at once, merge them together - farm: draw a field, plant a grid, harvest, replant - ranch: fence a pen, buy cows pigs sheep chickens, keep the trough full of corn, they breed and sheep grow wool - mine: draw a quarry and it digs a real pit into the terrain MAKING STUFF - sawmill logs into planks, smelt ore into bars, aggregate into glass - press bars into nails, wire, steel sheet, machine parts - carpentry / metal / electronics benches build basically every object in the game - butcher station and loom for meat and fabric - scrap anything back down into materials MARKET + MONEY - one global player run exchange, 35+ goods, real order book, instant buy or set a limit order and wait - almost nothing is npc priced anymore, if nobody is selling wood then there is no wood - bank with as many accounts as you want, savings that earn interest, send money to other players - live p&l so you can see exactly what every business makes per minute LOGISTICS - storage that requests and provides items, warehouse workers haul it around for you - delivery spaces say what a property wants and what it ships out - park a truck with a driver on it and it joins your network, thats it, no route building - you can get in and drive them yourself too - theres a console showing your coverage, whats starving, and flow lines out in the world WORLD - walk anywhere, click to path, up stairs, into buildings, into your own shop - see other players walking around with name tags, and their carts - fast travel between beds you own or jump straight to any of your carts - edit the world itself, place and delete buildings - inventory and gear you actually wear on your character - middle click almost anything to open its wiki page SOCIAL - built in chat, dms, friends, profiles - bug and suggestion boards with votes, screenshots attach automatically - loyalty points tied to your account for how much you actually do, not how rich you are #gaming #capitalrift #newgame #gamedev
zh: Capital Rift是一款基于真实世界地图的浏览器游戏，数据来自OpenStreetMap，所有玩家共享同一持久世界。游戏内容包括：摆摊售卖7种美食、雇佣员工自动化经营、购置和建造房产、开设商店、购买土地进行农牧矿业生产、加工制造各类物品、参与全球玩家驱动的交易所、建立物流网络，以及社交聊天等功能，支持离线运营。

d: An iconic scene 🫣 Before Freddy Krueger ever fully appears, A Nightmare on Elm Street (1984) delivers one of horror’s most unforgettable images: his razor-gloved hand slowly rising from the bathtub between Nancy Thompson’s knees. The scene perfectly captures Wes Craven’s genius for turning an ordinary, everyday moment into pure nightmare fuel. Instead of relying on loud scares, the slow, silent emergence of Freddy’s glove creates unbearable tension, reminding viewers that nowhere is safe once they fall asleep. The effect was achieved entirely with practical filmmaking, using a custom bathtub mounted over a water tank with special effects artist Jim Doyle submerged beneath Heather Langenkamp, making the moment feel remarkably convincing decades later. It’s a scene that has become one of the defining images of horror cinema and remains just as unsettling today.   #horror #freddykrueger
zh: 经典场景——在弗莱迪·克鲁格正式现身之前，1984年的《猛鬼街》呈现了恐怖电影史上最难忘的画面之一：他那戴着刀刃手套的手，从南希·汤普森两腿之间缓缓从浴缸中升起。这一幕完美展现了韦斯·克雷文的天才之处——将平凡日常瞬间转化为纯粹的噩梦素材。没有依赖突然的惊吓，弗莱迪手套缓慢无声地浮现，制造出令人窒息的张力，提醒观众一旦入睡，没有任何地方是安全的。这一效果完全通过实拍完成，使用了一个架设在水箱上方的定制浴缸，特效师吉姆·多伊尔潜伏在希瑟·兰根坎普身下，使这一幕几十年后依然令人信服。这个场景已成为恐怖电影的标志性画面之一，至今仍令人不安。

Legend says it’s the soul of someone whose burial shroud was never released… trapped, wrapped, and restless. They’re said to hop, not walk — bound by the cloth — appearing pale, bruised, and silent. If you ever hear knocking at night or see one watching from a distance… run. 👻 This clip is going viral right now, and honestly, the movement in the background gave me chills. Real or staged? 🎬 Munkar – Fear Rooted in Faith and Consequences Munkar is an Indonesian horror film that blends supernatural elements with themes of faith, guilt, and moral consequences. Set in a strict religious boarding school, the story follows a troubled student whose behavior begins to raise concern among teachers and classmates. After a disturbing incident, the atmosphere in the school changes. Strange and unsettling events start to occur, creating fear and confusion among everyone. It soon becomes clear that something beyond normal understanding is at play—something connected to past actions and hidden truths. The film builds tension through its eerie setting and emotional depth rather than relying only on sudden scares. It explores how fear can grow from within, especially when secrets refuse to stay buried. Munkar is not just a horror story—it’s a haunting reflection on choices, belief, and the consequences that follow #fypシ #fyp #movie #tiktok
zh: 《Munkar》——植根于信仰与因果的恐惧。这是一部融合超自然元素与信仰、罪恶感及道德因果主题的印尼恐怖片，故事发生在一所戒律严格的寄宿学校，讲述一名行为异常的学生引发师生担忧，随后校内接连发生怪异事件。影片通过阴森的场景氛围和情感深度营造张力，而非单纯依靠惊吓，探讨秘密无法掩埋时内心滋生的恐惧。

d: The Aswang is one of the most feared creatures in Filipino folklore. By day, it looks like an ordinary person, blending into villages unnoticed. But at night, it transforms into a terrifying predator that hunts humans, especially pregnant women and young children. Legends say the Aswang can separate its upper body from its lower half, sprout bat-like wings, and use a long, hollow tongue to feed on its victims from rooftops. For centuries, stories of the Aswang have been passed down across the Philippines, making it one of the world’s most infamous cryptids and supernatural beings. #folklore #filipino #aswang #fyp #viral
zh: 阿斯旺是菲律宾民间传说中最令人恐惧的生物之一。白天，它看起来与普通人无异，悄无声息地混入村庄。但到了夜晚，它会变身为可怕的猎食者，专门猎杀人类，尤其是孕妇和幼童。传说阿斯旺能将上半身与下半身分离，长出蝙蝠翅膀，并用细长的中空舌头从屋顶吸食猎物。几个世纪以来，关于阿斯旺的故事在菲律宾代代相传，使其成为世界上最臭名昭著的神秘生物之一。

d: "Mangkukulam" In Philippine folklore, a mangkukulam is a person, often depicted as a witch, who practices kulam, a form of black magic or witchcraft, and can cast spells or curses on others. They are known for using rituals, potions, and even voodoo dolls to inflict harm, illness, or misfortune on their victims. While often associated with negative actions, some mangkukulam are also believed to use their powers for healing or herbal magic, similar to an albularyo (witch doctor). #Mangkukulam #Philippines #Horror #Monster #Trending #Viral #AI #Veo3 #FYP

It was a lot.

d: Da Da Fei is a Chinese artist known for starting his drawings with chaotic, rough strokes that slowly transform into highly detailed portraits. In this piece, he creates Michael Jackson, gradually refining the sketch with sharper lines, depth and texture until the final image feels alive. What begins as disorder ends in precision, making the transformation especially satisfying to watch. At the end of his videos, he often leaves viewers with a thoughtful message, adding an emotional layer to the artwork beyond the drawing itself. Artist: 大大飞 / www6666666www on Douyin #art #drawing #portrait #michaeljackson #process
zh: 大大飞是一位中国艺术家，以凌乱粗犷的笔触起稿，逐渐转化为高度细腻的人物肖像而闻名。在这幅作品中，他创作了迈克尔·杰克逊，线条由粗到精，层次与质感不断深入，最终画面栩栩如生。从混沌到精准的转变过程令人赏心悦目。他常在视频结尾留下一段耐人寻味的话语，为作品增添了超越绘画本身的情感厚度。艺术家：大大飞，抖音账号：www6666666www

zh: 回复 @faridz zakaria：他分享了录像，不过这是另一只猫。母猫在交配后经常表现出攻击性，可能会转身攻击公猫，原因如下：一、疼痛反应：公猫生殖器有倒刺，抽出时会引起不适或疼痛，触发母猫即时的本能攻击反应；二、激素变化：交配后母猫激素激增引发排卵，情绪也可能骤变，导致攻击或烦躁行为；三、需要独处空间：交配后母猫不再接受公猫，身体也开始准备可能的妊娠，因此会主动与公猫保持距离。这些行为十分正常

d: Musakhan Kabsa @canarybasmati  Ingredients: - 7 to 9 onions - 2 chickens - 3 tbsps sumac - 2 cups @canarybasmati rice - 1/2 cup olive oil  Spices: - salt & pepper - 1 tsp cumin - 1 tsp coriander - 1 tsp cardamom - 1 tsp cinnamon - 1 tsp chicken stock powder ( 1 cube ) - 3 bay leaves - roughly chop the onions then add them to a pressure cooker along with the olive oil ( use 1/4 cup of olive oil if you want it lighter ) - saute the onions for about 5 minutes till wilted. Add the spices and continue stirring till their aroma fills the kitchen. - add the chicken with 2 cups of water ( or till the chicken is covered ) - shut the pressure cooker tightly and let it boil on high till it starts to whistle. Drop the heat to medium low and let the chicken cook for 15 minutes. - remove the chicken from the pot and broil it in the oven. - remove half of the onions from the pot for garnish then add 2 cups of washed & soaked rice. - adjust the salt and make sure that the stock level is directly on the rice ( not above it by more than half a cm) - shut the lid let it boil till starts to whistle. Drop the heat to the lowest possible and let it cook for 10 minutes - once all the steam has been released on its own open the pressure cooker.  - flip the rice on a serving plate. Top it with the onion and chicken. Garnish with coriander have it with yogurt & enjoy. #food #cooking #chicken
zh: 穆萨汉卡布萨烤鸡饭食谱：材料：洋葱7至9个、鸡2只、漆树粉3汤匙、金丝雀香米2杯、橄榄油半杯；香料：盐和胡椒、孜然1茶匙、芫荽粉1茶匙、豆蔻1茶匙、肉桂1茶匙、鸡高汤粉1茶匙（1块）、香叶3片；做法：洋葱粗切后放入高压锅，加橄榄油翻炒约5分钟至软，加入香料继续翻炒至香气四溢；加入鸡肉和2杯水（没过鸡肉为准），盖紧高压锅盖，大火烧至上汽后转中小火煮15分钟；取出鸡肉放入烤箱烤至上色；锅中留一半洋葱作装饰，加入洗净泡过的米2杯，调整盐分，确保汤汁与米齐平（不超过半厘米）；盖盖烧至上汽后转最小火焖10分钟；待蒸汽自然散尽后开盖，将米饭扣入盘中，铺上洋葱和鸡肉，撒芫荽叶，配酸奶享用

d: Nasi Goreng Indonesia - Indonesian Fried Rice #friedrice #easyrecipes #recipe  Ingredients 3 cloves garlic, minced 1 egg 3 cups cooked rice 4 slices fish cake, thinly sliced 4 large prawns, peeled and deveined A handful of fresh squid, cleaned and sliced 1 tbsp light soy sauce 2 tbsp kecap manis (sweet soy sauce) 1 tsp dark caramel sauce 1 tbsp sambal (adjust to taste) Large pinch of YumYum or MSG 1 bird’s eye chili, finely sliced 1 spring onion, thinly sliced 2 tbsp fried garlic Sliced cucumber and tomato, to serve Fried egg, to serve INSTRUCTIONS 1. Heat a wok over high heat and add a splash of oil. Add the minced garlic and stir-fry until fragrant. 2. Crack in the egg and scramble it quickly, breaking it into small pieces as it cooks. 3. Add the cooked rice to the wok and toss thoroughly, breaking up any clumps and ensuring it’s well-coated in the egg and garlic mixture. 4. Add the fish cake, prawns, and squid. Toss everything together and stir-fry until the seafood is cooked through. 5. Mix in the light soy sauce, kecap manis, dark caramel sauce, and sambal. Stir well to evenly coat the rice and proteins with the sauce. 6. Toss in the bird’s eye chili and sliced spring onion. Stir-fry briefly to combine. 7. Sprinkle the fried garlic over the rice and give it one final toss. 8. Serve hot, garnished with sliced cucumber and tomato, and top with a fried egg.

Batagor  📍 Bandung, Indonesia 🇮🇩 Taste Bandung: www.tasteatlas.com/bandung Short for bakso tahu goreng, batagor is one of Indonesia’s most iconic street food snacks. Rooted in Sundanese cuisine, the dish is traditionally made from a paste of Spanish mackerel (tenggiri) mixed with tapioca starch, garlic, and scallions. This savory fish mixture is either stuffed inside tofu or wrapped in thin wonton skins before being deep-fried to achieve a distinct crunch. Served cut into bite-sized pieces, batagor is generously topped with a warm, thick peanut sauce, sweet soy sauce (kecap manis), a squeeze of kaffir lime, and optional chili paste. What started as an inventive way to repurpose unsold steamed fish cakes in the 1970s has grown into a cornerstone of Indonesian street food culture. Video: @makmintenreal

d: 🍗 Ayam tuh potensinya banyak! Jangan digoreng terussss ❌🙅‍♂️ Jangan sampe potensi ayam sia-sia! Sekali-sekali, coba deh kalo punya ayam dibikin jadi ayam palekko khas Bugis gini.. Pedas, gurih, medoknya pasti sukses ngabisin beras 3 karung 😅🤣 emang deh, masakan Indonesia ga ada matinya! AYAM PALEKKO Bahan 1: • 500 Gr Ayam (potong 20 bagian) • 1 SDT Desaku kunyit bubuk • 1 ½ SDT Garam • 1 SDM Air Bahan 2: (blender/haluskan) • 6 Buah Bawang Merah • 3 Buah Kemiri (goreng) • 3 Cm Jahe • 3 Cm Lengkuas • 1 SDM Desaku cabe bubuk • 1 Batang Serai (ambil 10 cm bagian putihnya saja dan rajang • 3 SDM Air Bahan 3: • 5 SDM Minyak Goreng (untuk menumis) • 3 Lembar Daun Jeruk • 2 Lembar Daun Salam Bahan 4: • 250 ml Air • 2 Kelereng Asam Jawa (rendam dengan 3 sdm air panas, ambil airnya) • 2 SDT Desaku bawang putih bubuk • ½ SDT Ladaku merica bubuk • 1 SDT Gula Cara Memasak: 1. Campurkan semua Bahan 1 ke dalam kontainer. Kocok hingga tercampur rata. Diamkan selama 30 menit. 2. Blender Bahan 2, sampai halus. 3. Panaskan 5 sendok makan Minyak, tumis bumbu yang sudah diblender (Bahan 2) sampai naik minyak. 4. Tambahkan Daun Jeruk dan Daun Salam, tumis sampai mengeluarkan aroma. 5. Masukkan ayam, tumis sampai ayam berubah warna. 6. Masukkan Bahan 4, masak sampai mendidih. 7. Kecilkan api dan masak selama 10 menit dengan wajan tertutup. 8. Lanjutkan memasak dengan wajan terbuka sampai mulai berminyak dan kekentalan kuah yang diinginkan 9. Angkat dan hidangkan. #makassar #masakanrumahan #indonesianfood

d: Resep Ayam Goreng Padang (untuk 8 porsi) Bahan marinasi: 2 ekor ayam pejantan utuh 1 buah jeruk nipis bumbu halus Bahan bumbu halus: 6 siung bawang putih 2 sdt ketumbar 4 cm jahe, iris 4 cm kunyit, iris 8 cm lengkuas, iris 5 lembar daun jeruk, buang batang 2 sdt garam 2 sdt kaldu ayam bubuk ¼ sdt merica 1 sdt penyedap 75 gr kelapa parut 4 sdm tepung beras 2 butir telur Bahan sambal cabe ijo: 100 ml minyak 15 siung bawang merah 160 gr cabai hijau, potong 2 buah tomat hijau, iris 5 lembar daun jeruk 1 sdt garam 1 sdt penyedap Pelengkap: nasi putih timun, kupas jeruk nipis Cara membuat: 1. Untuk bumbu halus, siapkan blender dan masukkan bawang putih, ketumbar, jahe, kunyit, lengkuas, daun jeruk, garam, kaldu ayam bubuk, merica, penyedap, kelapa parut, tepung beras dan telur, lalu haluskan 2. Potong ayam menjadi empat bagian dan buang kulitnya. Marinasi ayam dengan perasan jeruk nipis dan bumbu halus, aduk merata. Diamkan minimal 1 jam di suhu ruang atau semalaman di kulkas 3. Goreng ayam yang sudah dimarinasi di minyak panas dengan api sedang hingga matang kecokelatan, angkat dan tiriskan 4. Untuk tambahan serundeng, goreng sisa bumbu marinasi hingga kuning keemasan lalu angkat dan tiriskan 5. Untuk sambal cabe ijo, panaskan minyak sisa menggoreng ayam, lalu masukkan bawang merah dan cabai hijau yang sudah dipotong, tumis hingga layu. Siapkan food chopper dan masukkan tumisan bawang merah dan cabai hijau, lalu haluskan sesaat 6. Tumis tomat hijau dengan minyak sisa tumisan bawang dan cabai. Tambahkan daun jeruk dan bahan sambal yang sudah dihaluskan, tumis sesaat. Tambahkan garam dan penyedap, aduk rata 7. Ayam Goreng Padang siap disajikan
zh: 巴东炸鸡食谱（8人份）：腌制材料：2只整公鸡、1个青柠、细磨香料；细磨香料：6瓣大蒜、2茶匙香菜籽、4厘米生姜切片、4厘米姜黄切片、8厘米高良姜切片、5片卡菲尔青柠叶去梗、2茶匙盐、2茶匙鸡粉、¼茶匙胡椒、1茶匙味精、75克椰蓉、4汤匙米粉、2个鸡蛋；青辣椒酱材料：100毫升油、15瓣红葱头、160克青辣椒切段、2个绿番茄切片、5片卡菲尔青柠叶、1茶匙盐、1茶匙味精；配菜：白米饭、黄瓜、青柠；做法：1.将大蒜、香菜籽、生姜、姜黄、高良姜、卡菲尔青柠叶、盐、鸡粉、胡椒、味精、椰蓉、米粉和鸡蛋放入搅拌机打细 2.鸡肉切四块去皮，用青柠汁和细磨香料腌制均匀，室温静置至少1小时或冰箱腌制一夜 3.中火将腌好的鸡肉放入热油中炸至金黄熟透，捞出沥油 4.将剩余腌料炸至金黄作为椰蓉配料，捞出沥油 5.用炸鸡剩余热油将红葱头和青辣椒炒软，放入搅拌机略打碎 6.用剩余油炒绿番茄，加入卡菲尔青柠叶和打碎的辣椒酱略炒，加盐和味精拌匀 7.巴东炸鸡即可上桌

d: Strawberry Nutella Brownies 🍓🤎 Perfect brownies for summer!  (recipe makes an 8x8 pan) Ingredients:  10 tbsp (140g) unsalted butter, melted 1 cup (200g) granulated sugar ¼ cup (50g) brown sugar, packed  2 eggs, room temp 1 tsp vanilla extract ½ cup + 2 tbsp (56g) unsweetened cocoa powder ½ tsp salt 1 tbsp (13g) vegetable oil ½ cup (63g) all purpose flour, spooned & leveled or weighed (don’t pack it in) ¾ cup chocolate chips 190g (~⅔ cup) Nutella  Topping: Strawberry slices, patted dry (as many as you want/enough to cover the top) Nutella (to spread over the top & drizzle)  Instructions: Line an 8x8 pan with parchment paper. Spread the nutella onto the parchment into a thin, even square the size of the pan. Freeze for at least 30 minutes or until frozen solid. Preheat oven to 325°F and line/grease an 8x8 pan with parchment. In a large bowl, whisk melted butter, granulated sugar, and brown sugar until smooth. Add eggs and vanilla, then whisk vigorously for 1-2 minutes. Stir in cocoa powder and salt until fully combined. Mix in oil, then gently fold in the flour until just combined (don’t over mix). Fold in chocolate chips. Spread half the batter into the greased pan. Place the frozen nutella sheet on top of it. Then, spread the remaining batter over it to cover the nutella layer completely. Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until a toothpick near the center comes out with no wet batter. It should just come out with a little nutella & slightly moist crumbs. Let the brownies cool completely. Spread a thin layer of nutella over the cooled brownies, add strawberry slices (patted dry) all over the top, and drizzle with more nutella.  Best enjoyed fresh!  #bakingrecipe #brownies #chocolatestrawberries #nutella #recipe

d: One of Thailand’s most famous dishes and I Couldn’t stop eating this when I was over there so I had to recreate it at home to  best ofmy abilities. Spicy, fragrant and absolutely delicious. 📝INGREDIENTS  -jasmine rice  -pork/beef/ chicken mince and for one serving I used around 250-300g  -Thai holy basil *I got mine from a international food shop. Shoutout @mattas1984 ( if you can’t source it Thai basil is a good alternative but remember it’s not the same , I’ve also seen people use 80% Italian basil and 20% mint with a pinch of clove) For the sauce I liked mine a bit darker so you don’t have to use these exact measurements, once you use the fish, oyster and soy sauce you’re on the right track. I’ve even some places use chicken stock and they have the meat more soft than crispy , it’s really down to you. -2tsp fish sauce  -optionally a tsp of light soy  -1tsp dark soy -2tsp of oyster sauce  -6 garlic  -7-9 Thai red chillies if you want it spicy , 3-4 if you want it mild. If you can’t get Thai red chillies , normal red chillies can be used. -cooking oil  -shallots  -fried egg  -green beans  As always in my videos I just get ingredients that aren’t pricey and I always get them from Aldi/Lidil/Asda , Asian markets near me or Amazon. Follow for more naasty recipes if you enjoy or watch the longer more in depth versions of my videos on my YouTube channel 👍✅ #padkrapao #thaïfood #thaicooking #holybasil #staynaasty

d: Salmon & Shrimp Fried Rice 🍣🍤 I could eat this every week😍 Ingredients • Day-old cooked rice • 2 salmon fillets • 1 pack medium shrimp • 6 eggs • 1 purple onion, diced • 1 green, 1 red & 1 yellow bell pepper, diced • 1 pack frozen peas & carrots • Spring onions • Soy sauce • Browning sauce • Oil Seasonings • Bouillon seasoning • Salt • Paprika • Onion powder • Garlic powder • Chili pepper Method 1. Whisk the eggs with a little salt and fry. Set aside. 2. Season and fry the shrimp and salmon. Set aside. 3. Sauté the onion, then add the bell peppers and peas & carrots. Season with bouillon, paprika, and chili pepper. 4. Add the rice, soy sauce, and browning sauce. Mix well. 5. Fold in the eggs, salmon, and shrimp. d: Garlic Parmesan Pasta🧄🧀 To all the dairy-intolerant mutants out there (including me)… this was soo good. Garlic + parmesan is a combination that never misses. Ingredients: 1kg chicken 500g fettuccine Parmesan (as much as your arteries can handle ) Oil or butter Chicken Seasoning: In the video 🙂 Sauce: 1 onion 8 garlic cloves 350ml double cream Parmesan Mozzarella Fresh parsley Salt Method: 1️⃣ Marinate the chicken for at least 1 hour with the seasonings shown in the video. I also added 2 tbsp of flour to give the chicken a light crust, but that’s completely optional. 2️⃣ Heat some oil in a pan and shallow-fry the chicken until golden on both sides. Once cooked, remove and set aside. 3️⃣ Meanwhile, cook the fettuccine in salted water until al dente. 4️⃣ Don’t wash the pan—we want all those flavours left behind. Add the onion and sauté until softened and browned, then add the garlic and cook for 1 minute. 5️⃣ Pour in the double cream and add a splash of pasta water to loosen the sauce slightly. 6️⃣ Add the cooked pasta and toss until fully coated. Stir in the parmesan, then taste before adding any salt, as parmesan is naturally quite salty. Add mozzarella too if you want an even creamier sauce. 7️⃣ Finish with fresh parsley, slice up the chicken, and serve it on top! #fyp #easyrecipes #garlic #parmesan #pasta

d: This ain’t your average mac and cheese🔥 Creamy gochujang mac & cheese topped with juicy steak and buttery shrimp, all made in a heart pan💓  The cream cheese makes it extra velvety, while the gochujang cuts through the richness with just the right amount of heat🔥 Creamy gochujang mac and cheese is my love language🍝✨Trust me—you’ll be obsessed after the first bite😍 📍Share with your pasta bestie & save this recipe for your next craving💗 ✨ Hailey’s Gochujang Cream Cheese Mac & Cheese 📝 Ingredients * 4oz elbow macaroni * 3 slices American cheese * 1 slice Colby Jack cheese * 2 tbsp cream cheese * ½–1 tbsp gochujang  * 1 cup heavy cream * 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese * ½ cup shredded mozzarella cheese * 1 tsp garlic powder * ½ tsp onion powder * ¼ tsp paprika * ¼ tsp black pepper * Salt * Grilled shrimp * Sliced steak * Parsley ⸻ 👩‍🍳 Instructions 1. Cook the macaroni until al dente. Reserve about ½ cup of the pasta water, then drain. 2. Over low heat, add the American cheese, Colby Jack cheese, cream cheese, and gochujang to a pan. Add the garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, black pepper, and a pinch of salt. Stir until the cheeses are fully melted and the mixture is smooth. 3. Pour in the heavy cream and add the cooked macaroni. Stir until the pasta is evenly coated. 4. Add ½ cup of the shredded cheddar and ¼ cup of the mozzarella, stirring until melted and silky. If the sauce is too thick, loosen it with a splash of the reserved pasta water. 5. Sprinkle the remaining shredded cheddar and mozzarella over the top. Cover and cook for about 1 minute, or until the cheese is melted. 6. Top with grilled shrimp or sliced steak, then garnish with chopped parsley and freshly cracked black pepper. 💡 Tip * American cheese and cream cheese are the secret to an ultra-smooth, velvety sauce. * Start with ½ tablespoon of gochujang for a milder kick, or use 1 tablespoon if you like it spicier. * The gochujang balances the richness of the cheese, making every bite creamy without feeling too heavy. * Taste and adjust the salt at the end, since the cheese and gochujang already add plenty of seasoning. #asmrfood #mukbang #gochujangmacandcheese #koreanpasta #fyp

d: แหนมสามชั้น  เปรี้ยว นัวกำลังดี ทอดกรอบๆ ทานกับน้ำพริก คือดีย์มากกก  วิธีทอดแหนมไม่ติดกระทะ คือใส่แป้งไปพร้อมน้ำมันเลยค่า กรอบ อร่อยสุดๆ ส่วนผสมและเครื่องปรุง  - หมูสามชั้นหั่นชิ้นกว้าง 2000 กรัม - ข้าวเหนียวนึ่งสุก 200 กรัม - กระเทียมสับหยาบ 200 กรัม - เกลือสมุทรป่น 3  ช้อนโต๊ะ  - พริกไทยป่น 1 ช้อนโต๊ะ  - ผงชูรส 2 ช้อนโต๊ะ - แป้งทอดกรอบ 3 ช้อนโต๊ะ  - น้ำมันสำหรับทอด 1/2 ลิตร *วางไว้อุณหภูมิห้อง 1 วัน ก็ทานได้แล้วค่ะ ใครชอบเปรี้ยวหน่อยก็ 2-3 วัน พอได้ความเปรี้ยวตามต้องการก็เก็บเข้าตู้เย็นได้เลยค่า  #แจกสูตร #แหนมทอด #สามชั้นทอด #ทำอาหาร

zh: 三层肉发酵猪肉（Naem），酸香恰到好处，炸得酥脆配辣椒酱，超级好吃。炸不粘锅的秘诀是直接把面粉和油一起下锅。材料：五花肉2000克、蒸熟糯米200克、粗剁蒜200克、海盐3汤匙、胡椒粉1汤匙、味精2汤匙、脆炸粉3汤匙、炸油半升。室温放置1天即可食用，喜欢更酸的放2-3天，达到喜欢的酸度后放冰箱保存。

d: Recipes Jordan Should Know Ep 5 | Hmong Sweet Pork #cooking #recipes  Hmong Sweet Pork❤️ Ingredients Pork & Marinade * 2 lbs pork belly, cut into thick cubes * 2 lbs pork shoulder, cut into thick cubes * 2 Tbsp oyster sauce * 2 Tbsp dark soy sauce * 1 tsp salt Marinate for 2–3 hours. Soy Sauce Eggs * 6 boiled eggs, peeled * Dark soy sauce (enough to coat the eggs) Marinate alongside the pork for 2–3 hours. Caramel Sauce * 1 cup white sugar * 1 cup water Cook the sugar until it caramelizes and turns a deep amber color. Carefully add the water and stir until completely smooth. Set aside. For the Dutch Oven * 2 Tbsp cooking oil * 6 cloves garlic, minced * 3-inch piece fresh ginger, thinly sliced * 2 stalks lemongrass, smashed and chopped * 2–3 star anise * 4–5 lime leaves * Prepared caramel sauce * Marinated pork * Marinated eggs Garnish * Green onions * Cilantro * Red peppers Directions 1. Heat the oil in a Dutch oven. 2. Sauté the garlic, ginger, and lemongrass until fragrant. 3. Add the marinated pork and brown on all sides. 4. Add the star anise, lime leaves, and caramel sauce. 5. Simmer over low heat for about 2 hours, skimming excess fat as needed. The pork should be tender, but not falling apart. 6. Add the soy sauce eggs and simmer for another 30 minutes. 7. Serve over hot rice and garnish with green onions, cilantro, and red peppers. Enjoy! ❤️

Everyone wants to lose weight until they find out it still takes effort in the kitchen. These cabbage dumplings make that part a whole lot easier. 🥟🥟🔥 Cabbage Dumplings Ingredients Ground chicken, 2 pounds Portabella mushrooms, finely diced, 8 ounces Scallions, finely sliced, 4 Soy sauce, 2 tablespoons Oyster sauce, 1 tablespoon Chicken bouillon powder, 1 teaspoon Salt and black pepper, to taste Small Napa cabbage, 1 to 2 heads Furikake, for garnish Chili oil, for serving Sliced scallions, for garnish Instructions Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Blanch the Napa cabbage leaves for 45 seconds to 1 minute, just until softened and flexible. Transfer to a towel and pat dry. In a large bowl, combine the ground chicken, mushrooms, scallions, soy sauce, oyster sauce, chicken bouillon, salt, and pepper. Mix until everything is well combined. Spoon the filling onto the base of each cabbage leaf. Fold in the sides and roll tightly to seal. Arrange the dumplings seam side down in a large skillet or steamer. Add 1/4 cup water to the pan, cover, and steam over medium heat for 12 to 15 minutes, or until the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165 degrees. Remove the lid and let any remaining water evaporate for 1 to 2 minutes. Finish with furikake, a drizzle of chili oil, and sliced scallions before serving. #dumplings #cabbage #healthyeating #food #foodtiktok

Save and share my recipe for Vietnamese Lemongrass Pork Chops for your next dinner. I grilled my lemongrass pork chops, but you can also air fry or fry in a pan.  Ingredients: 6 thin cut bone in pork chops 2 tbsps minced garlic  2 tbsps diced shallots 2 tbsps minced lemongrass  3 tbsps brown sugar  2 tbsps fish sauce  2 tbsps oyster sauce  2 tbsps olive oil  1 tsp black pepper  Instructions:  Cut slits around the pork chops and place in large bowl and all the ingredients in and mix. Cover and Refrigerate for 2-3 hours. Grill on each side for 4-5 minutes or air fry at 375f for 18- 20 minutes.  For scallion oil - heat neutral oil medium high and pour over sliced green onions.  Serve with rice, tomatoes, cucumber and a crispy fried egg.  #lemongrassporkchop #porkchops #vietnamesefood

INGREDIENTS: Pork Adobo - 1.2 kg pork belly (or cut of choice) - 15–20 cloves garlic, minced (adjust to taste—more is always welcome) - 1 onion, chopped - 500 ml pork broth - 190 ml soy sauce - 100 ml cane vinegar - 3 long green chilies - 4 bay leaves - 1 tbsp whole peppercorns - 30 g palm sugar, chopped (adjust to sweetness) - Oil, for frying Toppings - Sliced onion leeks - Crispy garlic bits - Boiled eggs INSTRUCTIONS - Fry the pork until lightly browned on all sides, then remove and set aside. - In the same pot, sauté the garlic until lightly golden and fragrant. Add onions and cook until softened. - Return the pork to the pot, pour in the pork broth. Add the soy sauce, vinegar, green chilies, bay leaves, peppercorns, and palm sugar.  - Cover and let simmer on medium heat for 5-10 mins **don’t mix to allow vinegar to cook.  - Turn to low heat for 1–2 hours, until the pork is tender and the sauce has reduced. you want it to be almost swimming in its own fat like a confit - Optional: If serving with eggs, add the soft boiled eggs 2-3 mins before serving to retain jammyness - Serve over hot rice, topped with crispy garlic and leeks, and a hard-boiled egg on the side. Enjoy. #FilipinoFoodBible #filipinofood #asmr #cookingasmr #pinoyfood

🇵🇭 Ngohiong | Filipino Food Bible Ep. 13 Cebuano ngohiong coming from Filipino Chinese influence -  is essentially a battered deep fried spring roll, filled with seasoned meat, vegetables, and the distinct aroma of five-spice.  But  what even makes it better is  its thick, sweet, savory, and spicy dipping sauce. *most measurements are estimates. Season and adjust to your liking :) INGREDIENTS: Wrapping: - Lumpia wrappers as needed Filling: - ½ kilogram of ground pork - 5 cups heart of palm/ubod, julienned - 1 white onion, sliced - 15-20 cloves of garlic, minced - Green Onion/Leeks - 1 tsp 5 spice powder - ¼ cup soy sauce - ¼ cup sugar - 2 tbsp of oyster sauce - 1 tsp of white pepper - 1 stalk of spring onions, sliced Dipping batter: - 1 1/2 cup flour - 1/2 cup cornstarch - 2 cups water - 1 tsp five spice powder - 1/2 tsp salt - 1/2 tsp black pepper - annatto for color  - 2 tbsp oil Ngohiong sauce: - 250g of potato - red chili to taste (labuyo) - 1 carrot, chopped - 15-20 cloves of garlic, sliced - 1 cup of vinegar - 1 tbsp of fish sauce - 1 cup of sugar - Annatto for color - 2 cups of Water INSTRUCTIONS:  - Saute garlic and onions in a pan. Add all the ingredients under “Filling,” then cook until the pork is fully cooked and everything is well combined. - Place filling near the bottom of each lumpia wrapper. Brush the top edge with a flour-and-water mixture, then roll tightly and seal. Set aside. - To make the dipping batter, combine all the ingredients under “Dipping Batter”. Dip each into the batter, then fry at 165°C for 4–5 minutes, or until golden and crisp. - For the ngohiong sauce, add all the ingredients under “Ngohiong Sauce” to a pot. boil until the carrots and potatoes are soft, then blend until smooth. - Serve the ngohiong hot and crispy with a generous amount of sauce, and enjoy! #cookingasmr #asmr #FilipinoFoodBible #filipinofood

🇵🇭 Kare Kare | Filipino Food Bible Ep. 10 Kare-kare is a rich Filipino stew made with oxtail, tripe, and vegetables, all simmered in a thick peanut sauce. It’s usually served with bagoong (fermented shrimp paste) on the side to balance the flavors and an extra level of umami and saltiness 😋 INGREDIENTS: Boiling liquid: - 1-2 red onions, chopped - 2 bulbs of garlic, chopped - 1 tbsp of salt - 1 tbsp peppercorns - 5-6 bay leaves - 1 kg of oxtail - 650g of ox tripe - Beef stock as needed Kare Kare: - 10g of annatto powder - 2 tablespoons oil - 15-20 cloves garlic, minced - 2 tbsp annatto powder - 1 white onion, diced - 1 banana heart, chopped, washed and rinsed w/ salt - Beef stock as needed - green beans, chopped - eggplants, quartered - pechay/bok choy - 1 ½ cup peanut butter - Patis to taste - ½ teaspoon salt - 1 tbsp of sugar (optional to taste) Toasted rice slurry: - 1:5 tbsp of water to toasted rice, blended Served with:  - Bagoong  - Crushed peanuts INSTRUCTIONS:  - Start by seasoning your meat with salt and pepper and sear. Add all ingredients under “boiling liquid” and fill the pot as needed with beef stock. Simmer until tender, remove meat and set aside the broth for later.  - Saute onions, garlic, and banana hearts in oil mixed with annatto powder. Add your meat back and cover with the broth from the boiling liquid and simmer for 15-20 minutes. - To thicken the mixture, add toasted rice to a food processor or blender. Take some of the rice and mix with water to form our slurry.  - Add both rice slurry and peanut butter stir and reduce to thicken. Season with patis/salt/pepper and add your vegetables.  - Serve alongside bagoong top and enjoy!  #CookingASMR #ASMR #FilipinoFood #PinoyFood

d: 🇵🇭 Ilocos Empanada | Filipino Food Bible Episode 4 A crispy pocket of goodness filled with sausage, egg and papaya originating from Ilocos in the northern region of the Philippines. Many variations exist but this is my take inspired by both the Vigan and Batac versions! note: adjust ratios of water/flour depending on flour brand since absorption rates may vary. Measurements are weighed but adjust to your preference! INGREDIENTS: Vigan Longganisa/sausage: - 1kg ground pork - 170g of garlic, minced - 80 ml spiced cane vinegar - 80 ml soy sauce - 2-3 tsp of ground black pepper - 1 tbsp of brown sugar - Salt to taste - pinch of MSG Spiced Vinegar: - 15-20 cloves garlic - 3 green chili - 9 birds eye chili - 15 shallots - 700 ml cane vinegar - 1 tbsp freshly cracked black pepper - 1 tsp salt - 30 ml fish sauce Dough (Yield 7-8 ~110g per ball): - 340g rice flour - 2 cups water - pinch of salt - 1 1/2 tbsp of chicken powder - 2 1/2 tbsp of annatto powder - 4 tbsp oil  Filling: - 2:1 ratio shredded green papaya to mung beans - salt/pepper to taste INSTRUCTIONS:  - for spiced vinegar blend together all ingredients under "spiced vinegar”. set aside - For the sausage, combine all ingredients listed under "Vigan longganisa” mix and let sir for 1hr - overnight  . Sear until rendered and crispy. - soak beans for about 1-2 hrs. Drain and boil for ~15mins until soft. - Shred papaya, add salt. squeeze water out. Combine w/ munggo and season w salt and pepper. - For the dough combine annatto powder, oil, salt, chicken powder and water. Boil and add to flour. knead until the texture resembles clay. you can combine w/ flour directly on stovetop. - roll ball of dough between cut plastic until thin - In the center place your papaya mixture and form a small hollow circle. add sausage, and egg at the center - Fold, tuck in the sides, and cut excess dough using a plate. Fry at 165C until crispy - Serve w/ spiced vinegar and enjoy! #FilipinoFoodBible #filipinofood #asmr #cookingasmr

d: 🇵🇭🍗 Max’s Style Fried Chicken INGREDIENTS: *some measurements may be estimates only so season and adjust to your liking 🙏🫶 Chicken Marinade: - 6pcs chicken leg quarter - 1/4 cup patis - 1/4 cup ml of calamansi - 10 cloves of garlic, minced Chicken blanching liquid: - 3 onions, chopped - 3 heads garlic, halved - 1 stalk of cilantro/wansoy - ¼ cup of calamansi juice - 3-4 bay leaves  - ¼ cup of peppercorn - ¼ cup of patis - 1-2 sachets of Maggi Magic Sarap - marinating liquid - Water as needed Chicken Drying: - 1 sachet of Maggi Magic Sarap - 1 tsp of baking powder Chicken Frying: - Oil as needed Sweet Potato Fries: - 6 sweet potatoes, fries cut - Water as needed - ⅓ cup of white vinegar - 1/4 cup of flour - ¼ cup of cornstarch - ¼ cup of rice flour - 1 tsp of baking powder - 1 tsp of baking soda - Water from soaking - Oil Dipping: - Banana Ketchup - Worcestershire sauce INSTRUCTIONS - Marinate the chicken w/ all ingredients under “marinade”. Set aside for 2hrs-overnight. - Transfer the chicken to a pot and add all the ingredients under “Chicken Boiling Liquid.” Pour in enough water to cover most of the chicken, low simmer for around 15 mins. - Combine the Maggi Magic Sarap and baking powder, then season the chicken evenly. dry in fridge overnight uncovered. - Soak sweet potatoes in water and vinegar. Reserve some soaking water before draining. Combine the potatoes, flour, cornstarch, rice flour, baking powder, and baking soda. add a little reserved soaking liquid to create a light batter. deep fry at 165°C for 4-5mins or until crisp. - For the dipping sauce, combine the banana ketchup and Worcestershire sauce. - Serve fried chicken with rice, sweet potato fries, and dipping sauce. Enjoy! #CookwithMagic #cookingasmr #asmr

🇵🇭 Beef Salpicao | Filipino Food Bible Ep. 12 My take on a delicious FIlipino-Spanish dish usually made with tender beef cubes cooked in garlic, butter and Worcestershire sauce — but with extra garlic flavor!  * this recipe is only a guideline. most ingredients are just estimates so taste and adjust with your ❤️ INGREDIENTS: Beef salpicao: - 500g ribeye steak (or any cut of steak of your choice) - 300g of button mushrooms - Salt and pepper to taste - Oil for frying - 1/4 block of butter - 15-20 cloves of garlic, minced - 3 tbsp of Worcestershire sauce  - 1  tbsp of oyster sauce  - 2 tbsp of paprika  Garlic confit: - 300g of peeled garlic cloves - Olive Oil to cover Garnish: - parsley - crunchy garlic - pickled peppers INSTRUCTIONS: - Start by seasoning your steak and grilling until medium rare. Slice them into bite sized chunks and set aside for later - Slice button mushrooms. In a pan , add oil and/or butter, sauté the button mushrooms until they get deeper in color. Season with salt and pepper.  - Add minced garlic to a hot pan with oil and butter, and saute unti fragrant. Add back your steak and mushroom and add Worcestershire sauce, oyster sauce, paprika and black pepper. - To make it extra garlicky, we’re adding some garlic confit. To make it, simply add peeled garlic to a pot, cover with oil, and cook low and slow until the cloves are soft and golden. - Serve with garlic rice and enjoy! #CookingASMR #ASMR # FilipinoFood #pinoyfood

Filipino Chicken BBQ (Inihaw na manok) Serves: 4–6 Prep Time: 15 minutes Marinate: Overnight Cook Time: 15–20 minutes Ingredients For the chicken & Skewers 	•	2-3 lbs Chicken Thighs deboned and cut in 4ths 	•	Wooden skewers, soaked in water for at least 2 hours BBQ Marinade 	•	1 cup ketchup (banana or tomato) 	•	½ cup soy sauce 	•	¼ cup calamansi juice (or lemon/lime juice) 	•	½ cup Sprite or 7Up 	•	8 cloves garlic, minced 	•	1 tsp garlic powder 	•	1 tbsp freshly ground black pepper 	•	1 tsp kosher salt BBQ Glaze 	•	1 cup ketchup 	•	1 tbsp soy sauce 	•	30g (about 2 tbsp) brown sugar 	•	3 cloves garlic, minced 	•	1 tsp black pepper 	•	1 tsp kosher salt Instructions 	1.	Marinate the Chicken In a large bowl or ziplock bag, combine all marinade ingredients. Add the chicken and mix well to coat. Cover and marinate in the fridge overnight. 	2.	Prepare the Skewers Soak wooden skewers in water for at least 2 hours to prevent burning. Thread the marinated chicken pieces tightly onto the skewers. Try your best to cover the chicken with the skin. This helps protect the chicken meat from overcooking. Packing them closely helps keep the meat juicy during grilling.  	3.	Make the Glaze In a bowl, mix together all glaze ingredients until well combined. No need to cook—this glaze will caramelize directly on the grill. 	4.	Grill the BBQ Preheat your grill to medium heat. Grill the chicken skewers for 12–15 minutes, turning every 4–5 minutes for even cooking. 	5.	Glaze and Finish Raise the heat to medium-high. Brush the skewers with the glaze and grill for another 1–2 minutes per side, letting the glaze slightly caramelize. Apply a second coat for extra flavor and color. 	6.	Serve Serve hot with steamed white rice or garlic fried rice. Pairs well with Filipino spiced vinegar (sawsawan)—check my page for the recipe! #filipinobbq #barbecue #recipe #food

d: Creamy Chicken Pastel One of the most underrated and creamiest Pinoy dishes out there! Try this recipe out — it’s comforting, flavorful, and perfect for any day of the week. For this recipe, we used Star Margarine, which really brings out the aroma and flavor of the ingredients. It’s also perfect for kids, with 10 growth-building nutrients that make every bite both delicious and nutritious! INGREDIENTS: Chicken Pastel: - 250g boneless chicken thighs - Oil for frying - 1–2 scoops Star Margarine Original - 10–12 garlic cloves, minced - 1 medium onion, diced - 1 pack brown button mushrooms - 1 carrot, chopped - 1 potato, chopped - 4–6 pieces Japanese sausage (or sausage of choice) - Red and green bell peppers, sliced - 1 cup chicken broth - Fish sauce, to taste - Pepper, to taste - ⅓ cup cooking cream Star Margarine Rice: - 1 scoop Star Margarine Original - Cooked rice - Crispy garlic bits (optional) INSTRUCTIONS: - Start by searing the chicken thighs until just cooked through. Chop them into bite-sized chunks and set aside. - In the same pot, add a scoop of Star Margarine and sauté the garlic, onions, and mushrooms until fragrant and soft. - Add the vegetables and stir, then return the meat along with the bell peppers and sausage. Pour in the chicken broth, fish sauce, and cream, and stir until combined. Set aside while preparing the rice. - In a bowl, add the rice and a scoop of Star Margarine. Mix until evenly coated. - Serve the chicken pastel with the rice and top with crispy garlic bits. Enjoy! #ASMR #cookingasmr  ASC REFERENCE No. M0331P121625S

d: Creamy Tuscan Chicken Pasta 🍝 Ingredients 1 chicken breast (cut in half) ½ tbsp paprika ½ tbsp garlic powder ½ tbsp onion powder 1 tsp salt 1 tsp black pepper Dash of olive oil 3 cups cooked pasta 2 tbsp olive oil 2 tbsp butter 1 small onion, diced 3 garlic cloves, minced 1½ cups cherry tomatoes, halved 1 tbsp tomato paste ⅓ cup sun-dried tomatoes 1 tbsp Italian seasoning 1 tbsp paprika Salt and pepper to taste ¾ cup heavy cream ½ cup pasta water 2 cups spinach (or less if preferred) 1 cup grated Parmesan cheese Instructions: - Season chicken with paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper. - Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the chicken and cook on both sides until golden brown and the internal temperature reaches 165°F. Remove from the pan and set aside. - In the same pan, add butter and diced onion. Cook until onions are translucent, then add minced garlic and cook for about 1 minute. - Stir in cherry tomatoes and cook for 2–3 minutes until softened. Add tomato paste and sun-dried tomatoes, stirring for another minute. - Add Italian seasoning, paprika, salt, and pepper. Cook for 1 minute, then pour in the heavy cream and pasta water. Stir well and let it simmer for 2 minutes. - Add spinach and Parmesan cheese. Stir until the cheese is melted and the sauce is creamy. - Slice the cooked chicken and return it to the pan. Let it simmer briefly to absorb the flavors, then add the cooked pasta. Toss until everything is evenly coated. - Garnish with extra Parmesan and serve warm and enjoy! #pasta #chicken  #ho#homemadefoodunch #dinner

d: 🇫🇷The Most Difficult Pastry to Make In France... Cannelés de Bordeaux  (Makes 21 lil guys)  White Oil… 100g Clarified Butter 40g Bees Wax 1. Melt the bees wax in a Bain Marie then add the butter be stir until homogenous. 2. Transfer to a storage container or coat your molds right away. Batter… - 470g Whole Milk - 125g Caster Sugar (1) - 30g Butter, unsalted  - Vanilla Bean Pod - 140g AP Flour - 125g Caster Sugar (2) - 100g Egg Yolks - 75g Dark Rum 1. Warm the milk, sugar (1), butter and vanilla bean pod in a sauce pot to 145F (63c). 2. Add the flour and sugar (2) in a large bowl and stir. Make a hole in the center of the flour and add the egg yolks. When the milk reaches temperature add 1/3 of it to the hole with the yolks and whisk to combine. Add the rest of the milk whisking until you have a smooth batter.  3. Let the batter cool slightly then add the rum. 4. Strain the batter and chill for 24-48 hours. 5. To bake the Canneles, preheat the oven to 465F (240c). 6. Remove the batter from the fridge just before use and stir until homogenous. Grease your molds then pour the leaving space towards the top. 7. Bake the molds for 8 minutes at 465F, then reduce the heat and cook for another 45-50 minutes at 350F (180c). 8. Remove the canales from molds immediately out of the oven. Allow the Canneles to cool fully before enjoying to allow the crust to develop and custard to finish cooking. Eat within 5 hours. - normally for cakes we don’t want gluten, but for these we want gluten because it’s important for its structure. Can’t overwork the batter, go nuts.  - Resting the batter ensures gluten is activated which is important for structure. Also, a cold batter stops the “popover effect” - Canneles are baked at high temp to set the crust, then the heat is lowered so the inside can cook evenly. The cold batter also helps ensure this process works well.  - The crust will harden as the Canneles cool. Let cool to room temp before slicing to them.  #frenchfood #caneles #pastry

d: im all for cheesy pasta but sometimes my stomach needs a break #nextlevelchef #nextleveldish #pasta #recipe #healthy #fyp  RECIPE Fake Alfredo Pasta 4 servings any pasta 2 cups reserved pasta water 1 16 oz package silken tofu 1 14 oz can artichoke hearts 3 oz boursin cheese (optional) 1 Tbsp miso (optional) 4 cloves garlic 2 tsp kosher salt 1 tsp red chili flakes 1 tsp dried oregano  Fresh ground black pepper Fried olive topping 3 Tbsp olive oil 1 cup castelvetrano olives, chopped 1 cup panko breadcrumbs Cook pasta al dente in salted water according to package instructions and reserve 1-2 cups of the pasta water before draining and setting cooked pasta aside. In a separate large skillet, fry the chopped olives in olive oil on medium high heat for 3-5 minutes. Add the breadcrumbs and a Tbsp more olive oil and toss to fry for another 5 minutes. Blend 1/4 cup pasta water, silken tofu, drained artichoke hearts, boursin cheese, miso, garlic, salt, chili flakes, oregano, and black pepper in a blender or food processor. Do not add more salt before mixing the sauce with pasta! Add the sauce to the strained pot of pasta. Add ½ cup of the reserved pasta water and toss pasta and sauce together on medium low heat, allowing the sauce to bind to the pasta for at least 5-7 minutes. Continue adding splashes of pasta water while the sauce gets glossy and thickens. Taste the sauce and adjust any seasonings to your preference.   Divide and serve pasta with generous helpings of fried olive and breadcrumb topping <3

d: Recipe Name Deep Dish Pepperoni Cheeseburger Pizza Pie Ingredients 1. 1 lb pizza dough 2. 1 lb ground beef 3. 1 cup pepperoni slices 4. 1 small onion, diced 5. 1/2 green bell pepper, diced 6. 3 garlic cloves, minced 7. 2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese 8. 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese 9. 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese 10. 1 cup pizza sauce 11. 1 tsp Italian seasoning 12. 1/2 tsp oregano 13. 1/2 tsp garlic powder 14. 1/2 tsp onion powder 15. 1/2 tsp salt 16. 1/2 tsp black pepper 17. 1 tbsp olive oil Recipe 1. Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C) and grease a deep cake pan or springform pan. 2. Press the pizza dough into the pan, covering the bottom and sides. 3. Heat olive oil in a skillet and cook the onion, bell pepper, and garlic until softened. 4. Add the ground beef and cook until browned. Drain excess grease. 5. Stir in pizza sauce, Italian seasoning, oregano, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper. 6. Spread half of the mozzarella over the crust. 7. Spoon the beef mixture evenly over the cheese. 8. Sprinkle the cheddar and Parmesan over the beef. 9. Arrange pepperoni slices on top and finish with the remaining mozzarella. 10. Bake for 35–40 minutes until the crust is golden and the cheese is bubbly. 11. Let the pie rest for 10 minutes before slicing. 12. Serve hot with extra pizza sauce if desired. d: Recipe Name Cheesy Crunchy Beef Tacos Ingredients 1. 1 lb (450 g) ground beef 2. 8 hard taco shells 3. 1 tbsp olive oil 4. 1 small onion, diced 5. 2 garlic cloves, minced 6. 1 packet (1 oz) taco seasoning 7. 1/2 cup water 8. 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese 9. 1/2 cup Monterey Jack cheese, shredded 10. 1/2 cup heavy cream 11. 2 oz cream cheese, softened 12. 1/2 tsp paprika 13. 1/2 tsp chili powder 14. 1/4 tsp black pepper 15. 1 diced tomato 16. 2 tbsp chopped fresh cilantro Recipe 1. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. 2. Add the onion and cook until softened, then stir in the garlic. 3. Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it into crumbles. 4. Drain excess grease and mix in the taco seasoning and water. 5. Simmer for 5 minutes until the mixture thickens. 6. In a small saucepan, melt the cream cheese with the heavy cream. 7. Stir in the cheddar, Monterey Jack, paprika, chili powder, and black pepper until smooth. 8. Fill each taco shell with the seasoned beef. 9. Spoon the warm cheese sauce over the beef. 10. Top with diced tomatoes and fresh cilantro. 11. Serve immediately while the shells stay crispy. Follow for more delicious recipes!

d: Recipe Name Loaded Beef Nacho Casserole Ingredients 1. 1 large bag (13–15 oz) tortilla chips 2. 1 lb (450 g) ground beef 3. 1 small onion, finely diced 4. 2 cloves garlic, minced 5. 1 packet (1 oz) taco seasoning 6. 1/3 cup water 7. 2 cups shredded Mexican cheese blend 8. 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese 9. 1 cup diced tomatoes 10. 1/3 cup diced pickled jalapeños 11. 1/2 cup salsa 12. 1/2 cup sour cream (for serving) 13. 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro 14. 1 tbsp olive oil 15. 1/2 tsp salt 16. 1/2 tsp black pepper Recipe 1. Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C) and lightly grease a 9x13-inch baking dish. 2. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and sauté the onion until soft. 3. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. 4. Add the ground beef and cook until browned, then drain any excess grease. 5. Stir in the taco seasoning, water, salt, and black pepper. Simmer for 3–5 minutes until thickened. 6. Spread half of the tortilla chips in the baking dish. 7. Top with half of the seasoned beef, half of the salsa, and half of both cheeses. 8. Repeat with the remaining chips, beef, salsa, and cheese. 9. Bake for 12–15 minutes, or until the cheese is fully melted and bubbly. 10. Remove from the oven and immediately top with diced tomatoes and jalapeños. 11. Garnish with chopped cilantro. 12. Serve hot with sour cream, guacamole, or extra salsa if desired. d: Serves: 4–6 Ingredients * 2 lbs chicken (thin-cut breasts, regular breasts, diced chicken, or boneless skinless thighs) * 1 (7.5 oz) tub Garden Vegetable Cream Cheese * ½ cup jalapeño jelly * ½ cup chicken broth * 3 tbsp ranch seasoning * Shredded mozzarella or pepper jack cheese Garnish with bacon crumbles or fresh parsley! Chicken Seasoning * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tsp smoked paprika * ½ tsp black pepper Directions 1. Preheat oven to 400°F. 2. Spray a 9x13-inch baking dish with cooking spray. 3. Place the chicken in the baking dish 4. Season the chicken with the garlic powder, smoked paprika, and black pepper. 5. In a bowl, whisk together:     * Softened Garden Vegetable Cream Cheese     * Jalapeño jelly     * Chicken broth     * Ranch seasoning 6. Pour the sauce evenly over the chicken. 7. Cover tightly with foil and bake according to the times below. 8. Remove from oven the last 5-10 minutes. take off foil, and top with shredded cheese. Place back in oven to melt cheese.  Remove and let sit for another 5-10 minutes to let the sauce thicken slightly. 9. Chicken is done when the thickest piece reaches 165°F. Spoon the sauce over the chicken before serving. Cook Times at 400°F * Thin-cut chicken breasts: 20–25 minutes * Diced chicken (1-inch cubes): 20–25 minutes * Regular chicken breasts (about 1 inch thick): 28–35 minutes * Large/thick chicken breasts (1½–2 inches): 35–45 minutes * Boneless skinless chicken thighs: 30–40 minutes Serve With * Mashed potatoes * White rice * Buttered egg noodles * Roasted broccoli * Green beans * Side salad #fyp #recipes #dinner

d: She Quit Her Job to Start a Farm. Then a DEAD GOD Got Involved - Neverway Neverway is a horror life sim and action RPG developed by Coldblood Inc. — co-founded by Pedro Medeiros, the pixel artist behind Celeste and TowerFall, and Isadora Sophia, a former senior Microsoft engineer — published by Outersloth, the publishing arm of Innersloth, the studio behind Among Us, coming to PC, macOS, Linux, Steam Deck, and Nintendo Switch in October 2026. The cozy half is a full life sim — farm, fish, cook, craft, and build relationships with over ten characters who have their own daily routines. The other half is fast action combat inspired by Zelda: A Link to the Past, with abilities unlocked through friendship bonds. The soundtrack is by Disasterpeace, known for Fez, Hyper Light Drifter, and the film It Follows. A free prologue is on Steam now. #horror #fyp #horrorgaming #indiegame
zh: 她辞职去务农，却卷入了一位死神——《Neverway》是由Coldblood Inc.开发的恐怖生活模拟动作RPG，联合创始人包括《蔚蓝》和《TowerFall》的像素画师Pedro Medeiros与前微软高级工程师Isadora Sophia，由《Among Us》开发商Innersloth旗下发行部门Outersloth发行，将于2026年10月登陆PC、macOS、Linux、Steam Deck和Nintendo Switch。游戏休闲部分是完整生活模拟——耕种、钓鱼、烹饪、制作，并与十余位有各自日常的角色建立关系；另一半则是受《塞尔达传说：众神的三角力量》启发的快节奏动作战斗，技能通过友情解锁。原声音乐由Disasterpeace创作，曾参与《Fez》《Hyper Light Drifter》及电影《It Follows》。免费序章现已上线Steam。

d: The viral “Chloe, we’re going to Disneyland” clip didn’t feel like it was trying to go viral — and that’s exactly why it did. During a surprise family announcement, one sister instantly exploded with excitement, while Chloe’s reaction was the complete opposite: stunned, overwhelmed, and giving that now-iconic side-eye that said, “Wait… what?” That split-second expression turned into one of the internet’s most recognizable reaction memes of the 2010s. d: Why you should uncrust your crusty dog! 🫣 Leaving too much buildup on your dog for too long can cause irritation and discomfort for your pet. The best way to prevent this is with regular grooming, keeping the eyes clean and cleared, cleaning around the eyes daily with pet friendly eye wipes, and finding the source of the irritant. It’s also beneficial to look into things that support healthy tear production like filtered water and supplements. Always make sure to use a gentle facial cleanser to avoid irritating their eyes and face. My personal fav is @tropiclean Blueberry Facial - it’s a great way to gently and throughly clean your pet’s face. #dog #doggrooming #tips #cutedog #catthedoggroomer

d: Cowboy butter steak bites ✨ My husband ate both of these plates and rated it a 10/10 😭 Ingredients  Steak - 2 pounds ribeye or sirloin steak, cubed - 1 tbsp neutral oil - 2 tsp Worcestershire sauce  - 2 tsp garlic powder  - Salt and pepper to taste (generous amount) “Caramelized” onions  - 1 large yellow onion, sliced - 1 tsp granulated sugar  - Heaping pinch of salt Cowboy butter - 12 tbsp unsalted butter - 5 garlic cloves, minced  - 1 shallot, minced  - 1 lemon, freshly squeezed - 1 tbsp Dijon mustard  - 1 heaping tbsp parsley, chopped - 1 heaping tbsp chives, chopped - 1 tsp thyme - 1 tsp cayenne powder (adjust to heat preference  - 1/2 tsp red chili flakes - 1/2 tsp smoked paprika  - Salt to taste  Instructions  - Toss cubed steak with oil, Worcestershire, garlic powder, and a generous amount of salt & pepper. Set aside while the pan heats. - Heat a skillet over medium heat with a little oil or butter. - Add onions, sugar, and salt. Cook 15-20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until soft, golden, and jammy. Remove from pan and set aside. - Crank heat to medium-high/high. Add steak in a single layer (work in batches if needed). - Sear 2–3 minutes per side until deeply browned. Remove and set aside. Lower heat to medium. - Add butter to the same pan. Once melted, add garlic and shallot — cook ~30 seconds until fragrant. - Stir in lemon juice, Dijon, parsley, chives, thyme, cayenne, chili flakes, smoked paprika, and salt. - Add steak back to the pan. - Toss to coat in the butter sauce for 1–2 minutes. - Serve over creamy mashed potatoes and enjoy! • • • #recipe #steak #dinnerideas #food #steak
zh: 牛仔黄油牛排块 我丈夫把两盘都吃完了，给出10分满分！食材：牛排（2磅肋眼或西冷牛排，切块）、中性油1汤匙、伍斯特酱2茶匙、蒜粉2茶匙、盐和胡椒适量；焦糖洋葱（大黄洋葱1个切片、细砂糖1茶匙、盐少许）；牛仔黄油（无盐黄油12汤匙、蒜末5瓣、切碎红葱头1个、柠檬1个榨汁、第戎芥末酱1汤匙、欧芹1汤匙、细香葱1汤匙、百里香1茶匙、卡宴辣椒粉1茶匙、红辣椒片半茶匙、烟熏红椒粉半茶匙、盐适量）。做法：将牛排块与油、伍斯特酱、蒜粉、盐和胡椒拌匀，静置备用；中火热锅加少许油或黄油，放入洋葱、糖和盐，翻炒15-20分钟至软烂金黄，取出备用；转中大火/大火，将牛排铺成单层煎制（可分批），每面煎2-3分钟至深褐色，取出备用，转中火；同锅加入黄油融化后放蒜末和红葱头炒约30秒至出香；加入柠檬汁、芥末酱、欧芹、细香葱、百里香、卡宴辣椒粉、辣椒片、烟熏红椒粉和盐搅拌均

d: Hot honey chicken sliders 🍔✨🍯 Ingredients  Chicken  - 1lb chicken breast, cut in half to create smaller pieces  - 1 1/3 cups buttermilk  - 1/4 cup hot sauce - 1/4 cup pickle juice  - 1 1/2 cup all purpose flour  - 1/2 cup cornstarch  - 2 tsp garlic powder  - 2 tsp onion powder  - 2 tsp cayenne powder (use less if desired) - 1 tsp smoked paprika  - 1 tsp mustard powder  - 1 tsp salt - 1/2 tsp black pepper  - 1/2 tsp msg (optional) - Oil for frying  - Slider buns Hot honey sauce - 2 tbsp unsalted butter  - 1/3 cup hot sauce  - 1/2 cup honey - 1/2 tsp brown sugar  - 1/8 tsp salt  Instructions: - In a bowl, combine chicken pieces, buttermilk, seasonings, pickle juice and hot sauce. Let sit for 3 hours (or overnight in the fridge for best results). - In another bowl, whisk together flour, cornstarch, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, mustard powder, cayenne, salt, and pepper. - Heat oil to 350°F (175°C). - Remove chicken from marinade, letting excess drip off. Dredge in seasoned flour mixture, pressing to coat well. Rest the floured chicken for 10 minutes before frying  - Fry in batches 4–6 minutes, or until golden brown and cooked through. Drain on a wire rack or paper towels.  - In a small saucepan combine honey, butter, and hot sauce. Mix until well combined. Let it simmer for 3-4 minutes then remove from heat - Brush chicken with hot honey sauce on both sides - Slice buns horizontally and brush with butter, place into a pan on medium high heat and toast until slightly golden brown.  - Mix melted butter, parsley and garlic powder. Brush over buns. • • • #hothoneychicken #friedchicken #DinnerIdeas #Recipe #hothoney #cooking

d: My Wife Has Been Begging Me To Make This… Loaded Potato Soup 4 large Russet potatoes cleaned 4 tbsps butter 2 tbsps garlic 1/2 chopped yellow onion 1/2 cup Flour 3 cups Milk 4 cups chicken stock (divided in half) Salt, pepper, and garlic powder to taste 1/2 cup sour cream 16 oz velvetta cubbed 3-6 crumbled strips of bacon Optional*** Garnish with bacon and green onion Poke holes in the potatoes with a fork, microwave them for 12 to 15 minutes until tender. Halve the potatoes and cut into chunks to cool In a large pot, melt butter over medium-low heat.  Add garlic and onion and cook until the onion is translucent Slowly whisk the flour into the pan and stir til slightly browned.  Slowly whisk in the milk 1 cup at a time. Then add the 1/2 chicken stock. Bring to a light simmer and whisk in the salt, garlic powder and pepper. Let come to a light simmer and thicken stirring occasionally  Add velvetta, bacon and the sour cream and stir til smooth Turn off heat, and fold in potatoes  I garnish with green onion and a little bacon and my wife LOVES IT, good luck!  Ps: I use half the chicken stock when I cook the soup and when I put it away for leftovers I add the additional 2cups to thin it out…. Personal preference, you’ll see #holmescooking #potatosoup #mealideas #cookingvideo #recipe

d: Chicken Alfredo garlic bread ✨🧄 This + a Caesar salad sooo good! Recipe is for two but can be used for one big longer French roll. Ingredients - 1 loaf French bread or Italian bread - 3 tbsp unsalted butter - 5 cloves garlic, minced - 2 boneless skinless chicken breast  - 1 cup heavy cream - 3/4 cup grated Parmesan cheese - 1 1/4 cup shredded mozzarella cheese (1/4 for pasta sauce the rest for bread) - 2 tsp garlic powder  - 2 tsp oregano  - 1 tsp basil - 1 tsp red chili flakes  - Salt and black pepper to taste - Fresh parsley, chopped (for garnish) Garlic butter - 1 stick unsalted butter, softened  - 2 tbsp parsley, chopped - 1/4 cup Parmesan  - 2 tsp garlic paste - 1 tsp garlic powder - Salt and pepper to taste  Instructions - Set to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. - Slice the loaf in half lengthwise. In a small bowl, mix softened butter, garlic paste, parsley, garlic powder, salt, pepper and stir until combined. - Brush evenly over both halves of the bread. Toast in the oven for 5–7 minutes until slightly golden. (Optional) - In a saucepan over medium high hear sear chicken breast on both sides for 5-8 minutes or until golden brown and fully cooked. Remove from pan. - In the same pan, add butter, and minced garlic. Cook until fragrant about 1-2 minutes. Add heavy cream and Stir until smooth. - Add mozzarella, Parmesan cheese and stir until melted and creamy. - Season with garlic powder, oregano, basil, red pepper chili flakes, salt and pepper. - Spoon the Alfredo sauce evenly over each bread half. Sprinkle extra mozzarella on top. Add sliced chicken and more Alfredo sauce. - Return to the oven for 15-25 minutes or until cheese is melted and bubbly. - Garnish with chopped parsley. - Slice and serve warm. • • • #Recipe #recipeideas #garlicbread #DinnerIdeas

d: Homemade in n out burgers 🍔 ✨  Can you believe I’ve filmed this exact thing 6 times and I finally liked how it turned out 😭 Full recipe below ⬇️  Ingredients  Burgers - 1.5 pounds ground beef (80/20) - iceberg lettuce - tomatoes, sliced  - american cheese or sharp cheddar, slices  - brioche buns - Salt and pepper to taste caramelized onions - 2 large white onions, diced - 1 tbsp olive oil  - 2 tbsp butter - 1 tsp granulated sugar - 1/2 tsp salt sauce  - 1 cup mayonnaise  - 1/4 cup ketchup  - 1/4 cup caramelized onions  - 2 tbsp pickles, finely chopped  - 1 tbsp yellow mustard  - 1 tsp distilled white vinegar  - 1 tsp sugar - 1/2 tsp salt  - 1/4 tsp black pepper  Instructions: - In a medium bowl, combine mayonnaise, mustard, ketchup, onions, pickles, salt, pepper, sugar, and vinegar together.  Cover and refrigerate while you prepare the rest. - Heat a small pan over low heat with 1 tbsp oil and butter. Cook onions slowly for 15–20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until soft, golden brown, and sweet. Set aside. Burgers  - Divide the ground beef into 4 equal portions (about 100g each) - Roll each into a ball, then flatten into thin patties about 1/4-inch thick. (Wider than the bun – they'll shrink.) - Season one side generously with salt and pepper. Keep chilled until ready to cook. Buns  - Cut the buns in half - Lightly butter the cut sides. - Toast them cut-side down in a dry skillet or griddle over medium heat until golden and crispy. Remove and set aside. Cook the Burger Patties - Heat a skillet or griddle over medium-high heat. Add a thin layer of oil. - Add patties (2 at a time, don’t overcrowd).  - Cook for 2 minutes on the first side until browned. Add mustard and spread evenly. - Flip and immediately add a slice of American cheese to each patty. - Cook for another 1–2 minutes, until cheese is melted and the patty is cooked through. - Assemble burger with sauce, desired toppings, and enjoy!  • • • #burgers #recipe #innoutburger #recipeideas #food #cooking #dinnerideas

d: 60 Day Fermented Honey Garlic Tomahawk Steak This cook was a long time in the making. I started by fermenting honey garlic, covering a mountain of garlic cloves with honey. I thought it would take 30 days, but it ended up going almost 60. Although I didn’t show it in the video, I dry brined the tomahawk steak overnight, then soaked it in the fermented honey garlic for three days. When I pulled it out, the color had deepened to a beautiful mahogany and the aroma was pure fermented honey garlic. For the cook, I set the steak on the grill over indirect heat until it hit 115°F internal, then seared it off. The honey caramelized quickly, so I flipped it often to keep it from burning too much. To balance the sweetness, I made a sauce with confit garlic and its oil, a spoonful of the fermented honey, a splash of dark soy, and plenty of ground black pepper. On the side, I made pomme purée dressed up with the confit garlic. The result was definitely unique, but I didn’t feel like I was eating a proper steak. Was it worth the long process? Absolutely not. The same dish without soaking the steak would be infinitely better, since the meaty notes of the beef would pair beautifully with the fermented honey garlic sauce without being overpowered.
zh: 60天发酵蜂蜜蒜香战斧牛排——这道菜筹备已久。我先制作发酵蜂蜜蒜，用蜂蜜浸泡大量蒜瓣，原以为30天就够，结果发酵了将近60天。虽然视频中没有展示，但我提前一晚对战斧牛排进行干腌，随后将其浸泡在发酵蜂蜜蒜中三天。取出时，牛排颜色加深，呈现出漂亮的红棕色，散发着浓郁的发酵蜂蜜蒜香。烹饪时，我先用间接热源烤至内部温度达到115°F，再进行煎烤。由于蜂蜜焦糖化很快，我频繁翻面以防烧焦。为平衡甜味，我用油封大蒜及其油脂、一勺发酵蜂蜜、少许老抽和大量黑胡椒制作了酱汁。配菜是用油封大蒜点缀的法式土豆泥。成品口味独特，但总感觉不像在吃一块正宗牛排。这漫长的过程值得吗？完全不值。不经浸泡直接烹饪的效果会好得多，牛肉本身的鲜味与发酵蜂蜜蒜酱搭配会更加和谐，而不会被掩盖。

d: Eggnog recipe 👇🏼🎄 Eggnog feels like something you only see people drinking in 90s Christmas movies. But let me tell you, when I made this batch and took my first sip, I couldn’t believe it had taken me this long to try it for myself. Don’t let the ‘egg’ in the title put you off — it doesn’t taste eggy in the slightest, and in this version you make sure the egg is cooked, like you would with a custard. Eggnog 6 eggs 100 g caster sugar 750ml milk 250 ml cream 1/2 tsp nutmeg 1 cinnamon stick or 1/4 tsp ground cinnamon 1 tsp vanilla extract Meringue 180 g caster sugar Pinch salt Separate the eggs yolks from the whites and place the yolks in a large bowl with the caster sugar. Whisk together until the eggs are pale and fluffy. Add the milk, cream, nutmeg, cinnamon and vanilla to a small saucepan over medium heat, stirring well until the milk is hot but not boiling. Remove from the heat and discard the cinnamon stick. Next, temper the eggs — pour the milk little by little into the eggs, whisking well between each addition. This ensures the eggs don’t scramble! Once you’ve added all the milk, pour the mixture back into the saucepan and return to the heat until it’s nice and hot but not boiling. Remove from the heat and set aside. To make the meringue, add half the egg whites to a mixing bowl with the caster sugar and set over a pan of gently simmering water, whisking until the sugar is dissolved and the egg whites have reached 70ºC. This should take about 4-5 minutes — it’ll be hot to the touch. Remove from the heat and beat with an electric mixer for about 10 minutes or until it looks glossy and holds stiff peaks.  Pour the warm eggnog into mugs, spoon with meringue and finish by caramelising it with a blow torch (this is optional to give it that toasty flavour). #cookingfromscratch #wholesomefood #fromscratchcooking #christmasbaking #eggnog

EASY MEALS FOR 2, EP. 24 🍯 Honey Garlic Chicken Ingredients Chicken * 375g-400g boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-sized pieces * 1 tsp salt * 1 tsp garlic powder * ½ tsp black pepper * ¼ cup cornstarch Sauce * 60g honey (about 3 tbsp) * 2 tbsp soy sauce * 1 tbsp oyster sauce * 1 tbsp rice vinegar * 19g garlic, minced (4–5 large cloves) * 12g green onion whites, finely sliced Cornstarch Slurry * 1 tsp cornstarch * 2 tsp water Garnish * Sesame seeds * Sliced green onion greens Directions 1. Toss the chicken with the salt, garlic powder, pepper, and cornstarch until evenly coated. 2. Heat enough neutral oil to lightly coat the bottom of a pan. Shallow fry the chicken over medium-high heat until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside. 3. Reduce to medium heat. If needed, add a little more oil, then sauté the garlic and green onion whites for 30–60 seconds until fragrant. 4. Pour in the honey, soy sauce, oyster sauce, and rice vinegar. Simmer for 1–2 minutes. 5. Stir in the cornstarch slurry and cook until the sauce thickens. 6. Return the chicken to the pan and toss until every piece is well coated. 7. Garnish with sesame seeds and green onions greens Serve with steamed rice and enjoy! 🍚 #honeygarlicchicken #chickenrecipe #easyrecipe #cooking #creatorsearchinsights

d: Easy Kimchi Recipe ingredients - 1 Napa cabbage - Gochugaru - 1 Onion - 2 Green onions (optional) - 200g Chive (optional) - 200g Garlic (adjustable) - 25g Ginger (optional) - Fish sauce - Sugar - Salt - MSG (secret ingredient) - Flour (any flour is okay) Seasoning (for 1 Napa cabbage) 1. Put 1 onion, 200g garlic (adjustable), 25g ginger (optional), 100g water, 50g sugar, 1 tablespoon MSG, 100g fish sauce into the blender and blend (vegetable paste) 2. Put 3 tablespoons flour, 200g water and mix 3. Put it to microwave for 30 seconds, stir, microwave for another 30 seconds (flour paste) 4. Cut green onions into 1cm pieces, and cut chive into 3cm pieces. 5. Mix 200g gochugaru, vegetable paste, flour paste, green onions, and chive 6. Adjust the seasoning with fish sauce if it's not salty enough. Recipe (for 1 Napa cabbage) * Cut the Napa cabbage into approximately 3cm x 3cm pieces. * Place the cut cabbage in a large bowl. * Add a mixture of 1 cup of salt and 1 cup of water to bowl * Let it soak for 1 hour * After 1 hour, rinse the cabbage three times with water. * If the cabbage is still too salty after rinsing, soak it in water for about 30 minutes to reduce the salty taste. * Mix the seasoning paste with the soaked cabbage. * Ferment at room temperature for 3-4 days and store it in the refrigerator #kimchi #tiktokfood #koreanfood
